name: last30days
description: Deep research engine covering the last 30 days across 10+ sources - Reddit, X/Twitter, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Hacker News, Polymarket, and the web. Synthesizes findings into grounded, cited reports.
author: mvanhorn

capabilities.title: Topic Research
capabilities.description: Research any topic across Reddit, X/Twitter, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Hacker News, Polymarket, and the web from the last 30 days.

capabilities.title: Comparative Analysis
capabilities.description: Side-by-side comparison of two topics (e.g. 'Claude Code vs Codex').

capabilities.title: Watchlist Management
capabilities.description: Set up recurring research topics to monitor over time.

capabilities.title: Morning Briefings
capabilities.description: Generate briefings from accumulated watchlist research.

optional_api_keys.OPENAI_API_KEY: Reddit search via OpenAI responses API
optional_api_keys.XAI_API_KEY: X search via xAI Grok API
optional_api_keys.OPENROUTER_API_KEY: Web search via Perplexity Sonar Pro
